## Design organization

For full product screens and journeys, classify the deliverable before creating
it. A complete journey is not a Pattern merely because it uses reusable patterns
internally.

- Start unresolved directions in `Explorations`.
- After explicit approval, place product screens in the durable product page for
  their audience, workspace, domain, or lifecycle area and group them in a named
  journey section.
- Promote only compositions with a clear reusable contract to `Patterns`; keep
  journey-specific copy, data, and navigation with the product screens.
- Use frames for screens by default. Create screen components or variants only
  for demonstrated reuse or meaningful state axes.
- Select viewport, theme, state, accessibility, and recovery coverage
  proportionately rather than multiplying variants mechanically.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use canonical Blockout components and established design tokens where applicable.
- [ ] Cover iOS, Android, relevant states, keyboard focus, touch targets, text scaling, and readability.
- [ ] Add exact node links and screenshots in the evidence comment.
- [ ] Obtain explicit human approval before closing. A Figma-only delivery has no documentation pull request.
